HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

3. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

9. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

13. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict, Transformation and Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
